findings.justification: This passage from the 10-K for fiscal year 2025 explicitly states net income for fiscal year 2025 was $101,832 million and for fiscal year 2024 was $88,136 million, with a 16% increase. Since 16% > 10%, this entails that net income increased by more than 10%.

E7 shows net income for FY2025 (2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30) was $101,832,000,000. E8 shows net income for FY2024 (2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30) was $88,136,000,000. The year-over-year growth is (101,832 - 88,136) / 88,136 = 0.1554 or 15.54%, which is greater than 0.1 (10%).

This derived metric directly calculates the year-over-year growth of net income for the annual period ending 2025-06-30 as 0.1554 (15.54%), which is greater than 0.1 (10%). The period status is COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION, confirming this is the correct calculation for the claim period.

E7 provides net income for fiscal year 2025 (2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30) of $101,832,000,000. E8 provides net income for fiscal year 2024 (2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30) of $88,136,000,000. The increase is (101,832 - 88,136) / 88,136 = 15.54%, which is more than 10%.
